name: Minimal Java Jupyter
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-venv && python3 -m venv ~/jupyter-env && ~/jupyter-env/bin/pip install jupyterlab jupyter_client && wget https://github.com/SpencerPark/IJava/releases/download/v1.3.0/ijava-1.3.0.zip && unzip ijava-1.3.0.zip -d ijava-kernel && ~/jupyter-env/bin/python ijava-kernel/install.py --sys-prefix && rm -rf ijava-kernel ijava-1.3.0.zip
